endpoints.name: Delete Influencer Scheme

idempotency.notes: Repeating the call after success will typically return not-found or no change

endpoints.detailed_description: Delete influencer scheme. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IInfluencerScheme.GetInfluencerSchemeById, ICommon.ToJsonString, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: SchemeHeader: UPDATE, soft delete (is_deleted flag), AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid scheme ID is required. [when id <= 0]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.not_found: 404: Influencer Scheme not found. [when existingInfluencerScheme == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when current_user == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to delete influencer scheme
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Delete influencer scheme — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IInfluencerScheme.GetInfluencerSchemeById, ICommon.ToJsonString, writes an audit log entry
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) id must reference existing record(s); passes 3 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.state_changes: SchemeHeader: UPDATE; soft delete (is_deleted flag); AuditLog: INSERT
business_logic.side_effects: AuditLog DELETE (Settings > CRM Settings > Influencer Scheme)
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid scheme ID is required. [when request.Id <= 0]; At least one field must be provided for update. [when request.Title == null && request.SchemeTypeId == null && request.BranchId == null && reque]; message built at runtime [when !result.Success]

endpoints.name: Create Influencer Mapping

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; a duplicate check exists so repeating usually fails with a conflict/validation message

endpoints.detailed_description: Create influencer mapping. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IInfluencerScheme.GetSchemeHeaderById, IInfluencerScheme.GetInfluencerById. Persists changes to: SchemeMapping: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; At least one Influencer ID is required. [when request.influencerId == null || request.influencerId.Count == 0]; Valid dealer ID is required. [when request.schemeHeaderId <= 0]; Dealer not found. [when schemeHeader == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
error_handling.business_rule_errors: No mappings were created. Check Influencer IDs or duplicates. [when createdMappings.Count == 0]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create influencer mapping
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Create influencer mapping — validates the request, checks for an existing/duplicate record, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IInfluencerScheme.GetSchemeHeaderById, IInfluencerScheme.GetInfluencerById
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; request body of type CreateInfluencerMapping (inline); passes 5 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.validations: ModelState (DTO data-annotation) validation; Invalid data provided.; At least one Influencer ID is required.; Valid dealer ID is required.; Dealer not found.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: At least one Influencer ID is required.
No mappings were created. Check Influencer IDs or duplicates.
